name: Type: Bug
description: Incorrect behavior, broken functionality, or a regression.

name: Type: Enhancement
description: Improve an existing capability, including its API, usability, or performance.

name: Type: Feature
description: Add a new capability.

name: Type: Design
description: Explore a design, API shape, or direction before an actionable proposal exists.

name: Type: Documentation
description: Documentation, examples, or contributor instructions.

name: Type: Testing
description: Tests, benchmarks, Miri, fuzzing, or other verification.

name: Type: Maintenance
description: Dependencies, toolchain, CI, releases, refactoring, or repository upkeep.

name: Type: Question
description: Ask how the project works or how to use it.

name: Type: Tracking
description: Index of related issues or a review report; closes when its items are resolved.

name: Status: Confirmed
description: Reproduced defect, or request the maintainer has accepted; not a delivery commitment.

name: Status: Needs Information
description: Waiting for reporter details, answers, or validation results.

name: Status: Blocked
description: Waiting on another issue, an unreleased dependency, or another stated external condition.

name: Status: Can't Reproduce
description: A documented reproduction attempt did not reproduce the report.

name: Status: Duplicate
description: Already tracked elsewhere; link the canonical issue or PR.

name: Status: Won't Do
description: Declined as out of scope or unsuitable in its proposed form.

name: Needs: Decision
description: Waiting for a maintainer decision on design, API, naming, scope, or policy.

name: Needs: Review
description: Awaiting the maintainer's review and approval; a pull request carrying it must not merge.

name: Breaking Change
description: Requires a semver-incompatible release.

name: Soundness
description: Concerns unsafe code or memory safety: safety arguments, unsound APIs, or undefined behavior.

name: Performance
description: Concerns speed, allocation, or memory use.

name: Experiment
description: Concerns an experimental branch or proof of concept, not mainline code.

name: Good First Issue
description: A scoped, ready task with a clear approach and beginner-friendly validation.

name: Help Wanted
description: A scoped, accepted task for which outside contributions are welcome.
